_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. We apply science and our global resources to improve health and well-being at every stage of life' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1); 'Competition from manufacturers of generic drugs is a major challenge for us around the world, and the loss or expiration of intellectual property rights can have a significant adverse effect on our revenues. Upon the expiration or loss of patent protection for one of our products ... we can lose the major portion of revenues for that product in a very short period of time' (Item 1A); biopharmaceutical revenues 'decreased 17% in 2012 compared to 2011, primarily reflecting lower revenues from Lipitor, Geodon, Caduet, Xalatan and Aromasin, all due to the loss of exclusivity' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1); 'Our businesses are conducted in intensely competitive and often highly regulated markets'

classification.quality_note: 'is a research-based, global biopharmaceutical company. Upon the expiration or loss of patent protection for one of our products ... we can lose the major portion of revenues for that product in a very short period of time' (Item 1A); biopharmaceutical revenues 'decreased 17% in 2012 compared to 2011, primarily reflecting lower revenues from Lipitor, Geodon, Caduet, Xalatan and Aromasin, all due to the loss of exclusivity' (FY2012 10-K, Item 1); 'Our businesses are conducted in intensely competitive and often highly regulated markets'. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price rich; Ratio B 4.28x; +11% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap -1.20; conservative 2yr +8%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -28.7%/yr (worst year FY04-FY12, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-2.8%/yr (FY13 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 9.2-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +-1.6%/yr (FY04-FY12 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +10.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY12); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PFE (retrospective, 2013-03-15) ✕ AVOID — Ratio B 4.28x (60.7% downside to Bear $11 / +14.2% upside to Bull $32) | Adj composite 2.03 vs market 3.23: gap -1.20 [OVERVALUED] | +11% above the EPP floor $25 (16x FY13E $1.57) | Conservative 2-yr case: +8.2% total (+4.1%/yr) | At 17.8x FY13E the 15% hurdle price $37 sits above the BULL case; U.S. revenues -8.6% in Q4 2012, forward revenues -4.7% to -1.3% (FY13 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
